gloss: to get off (a vehicle); to alight

definitions.gloss: to get off (a vehicle); to alight; to disembark
definitions.explanation: To exit a train, bus, or other public transport vehicle at a particular stop or station.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}で{下車|げしゃ}する。
examples.english: I'll get off at the next station.

examples.japanese: {東京駅|とうきょうえき}で{下車|げしゃ}して{乗|の}り{換|か}えてください。
examples.english: Please get off at Tokyo Station and transfer.

examples.japanese: {終点|しゅうてん}の{一|ひと}つ{手前|てまえ}で{下車|げしゃ}した{方|ほう}が、{目的地|もくてきち}には{近|ちか}いですよ。
examples.english: Getting off one stop before the last stop is closer to your destination.

notes:
A formal word for getting off a train, bus, or similar vehicle. In everyday conversation, {降|お}りる is more common, but {下車|げしゃ} appears frequently in announcements, signage, and written instructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {途中|とちゅう}{下車|げしゃ}: stopover, getting off partway through a journey
- ～で{下車|げしゃ}する: to get off at ~
- {下車|げしゃ}{駅|えき}: the station where one gets off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {降|お}りる: to get off — the everyday word for exiting a vehicle
- {乗車|じょうしゃ}する: to board — the opposite, getting on a vehicle
- {下船|げせん}する: to disembark (from a ship) — used specifically for boats and ships
